judged_text: The ~20-line "fetch credential from DB and map appName" block is hand-duplicated in createAllCalendarEvents, again in updateAllCalendarEvents, and in a divergent third variant in handleCancelBooking that omits the app include and appName mapping both EventManager copies perform. The three hand-maintained copies have already drifted (the cancel path's fetch lacks the app relation the EventManager copies deem necessary to resolve the calendar service), so any future change to credential resolution must be applied in three places and will miss the divergent one — biting collective hosts whose calendar events silently stop being deleted.

adjudication.rationale: The diff shows the same “fetch credential from DB + map to a credential object” logic duplicated in at least two places in `packages/core/EventManager.ts` (in `createAllCalendarEvents` and again when iterating calendar references in `updateAllCalendarEvents`), both using `prisma.credential.findUnique({ include: { app: { select: { slug: true }}}})` and then building an object with `appName: credentialFromDB.app.slug`. In `packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts`, a third similar credential-fetch fallback was added, but it uses `prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: credentialId }})` with no `app` include and no `appName` mapping. This is a concrete maintainability/consistency issue introduced by the change (the three copies have already drifted), even though the exact runtime impact claimed (silent failure to delete for collective hosts) cannot be conclusively verified from the diff alone.
